# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository is governed by the root `AGENTS.md`.

Copilot and Copilot Coding Agent MUST:

- Read `AGENTS.md` before implementation.
- Read any nearer local `AGENTS.md` files for touched paths.
- Use `.agent/skills/README.md` to identify relevant tool-independent skills, then read only those skills.
- Follow repository scripts and validation rules from `AGENTS.md`.
- Keep changes scoped and final output concise.
